correctness.rationale: The four displayed orthogonal projectors diagonalize the crown combinatorial Laplacian at 0, 2(n-1), n and n-2. Kantorovich duality reduces each of three automorphism orbits to an explicitly solved finite linear program. Sign conditions for beta follow from the finite geometric sum bound; the n=3 missing generic edge is handled separately. Each upper bound has an explicit globally edge-1-Lipschitz attaining witness. Exact rational reproduction with the included script checks 24 rational heat matrices, 72 witnesses and 2359 integer potentials on n=3..5; the infinite quantifiers rely on the analytic proof, not the tests.

value.rationale: Crown graphs form a canonical infinite family of distance-regular bipartite graphs of diameter three. Determining all three exact, attained heat-W1 profiles supplies sharp transport benchmarks for every separation, not merely a one-step curvature estimate. The disappearance of the n-eigenmode from all Wasserstein maxima and the uniquely exceptional six-cycle failure of equality along a geodesic are structural consequences with direct relevance to semigroup gradient stability and transport geometry. They cannot be recovered by a routine substitution into known complete-multipartite formulas.
